prompt:
Create an exact GPT Image 2 design mockup for existing DooKnow UI. Render one readable complete app-owned window with sufficient host context. Never pretend independent panels are simultaneously open. Captions outside app UI state source ID/title/role/state.
ASSET WS-D003 Sidebar notebook and directory search
VIEWPORT Readable desktop full window/panel; independent board views each use a1440px desktop host or readable window crop.

FOCUS Search query/mode/directory and current result groups/paging/degraded explanation.
Actual ToDoo screenshot is STYLE ONLY (hierarchy, palette, typography, spacing, density); brand DooKnow. Actual platform screenshot is CONTENT/ROLE reference, not target style. Fictional legal examples only; masked secrets and example.invalid URLs.
COMPLETE FIELDS IN SOURCE ORDER:
WS-003 搜索词 [search; optional]: No additional client constraint found; server validation not otherwise verified.
WS-003 搜索模式 [select; required]: hybrid | text | semantic; semantic label indicates preparation when vector not ready.
WS-003 搜索目录 [directory; optional]: Existing folder or all directories.
IMPLEMENTED ACTION WHITELIST:
WS-003 搜索 / 加载更多: Run paginated advanced search; merge with filename results; guard: Owner session; control-specific guards described in permissionRules.
WS-003 搜索结果: Open note at matching line or directory; guard: Owner session; control-specific guards described in permissionRules.
WS-003 重试搜索: Repeat current search; guard: Owner session; control-specific guards described in permissionRules.
WS-003 检查搜索设置: Navigate settings/search; guard: Owner session; control-specific guards described in permissionRules.
PERMISSIONS:
Authenticated owner browser session; /api owner hook returns 401 if absent and 503 during maintenance. Mutations require configured Origin and CSRF token (apps/server/app.ts:141). No administrator/member role split is implemented for these owner surfaces.
ALL IMPORTANT STATES (stateCoverage maps visible/shared-pattern/nonvisual rules; never depict incompatible alternatives together):
WS-003: Searching
WS-003: Index updating/waiting
WS-003: No matches
WS-003: Degraded hybrid/semantic result with explanation
WS-003: Error and retry
WS-003: Paginated results including folder, filename and content matches
SOURCE NOTES:

RESPONSIVE Linked390/320 jobs handle compact field order/drawer/stacking and safe scrolling. 
FORBIDDEN:
Brand is DooKnow; ToDoo is an existing app and style reference only.
No invented fields, actions, role hierarchy, authentication gate, password sharing gate, automatic save guarantee or backend expansion.
No real secrets, share capabilities or private data: use fictional legal example content, example.invalid URLs, masked secret fields.
Never render API protocol metadata requestId/hash/cursor/expectedVersion as editable fields unless the actual source UI has that input.
No native OS/browser picker or print-dialog chrome.
No owner account/tree/file/share-management/upload/generate controls in a public guest or standalone export host.
No developer/source/API path or review-note text inside product UI.
All mockups and per-image/global functional reviews must pass before product development. Do not draw protocol metadata as form controls.
EXECUTION CLARIFICATIONS FROM EXISTING SOURCE: Render only one normal paginated search state with a short hybrid-search degraded explanation, not the incompatible searching/error/empty alternatives. Search controls in order: 搜索笔记与目录 query set to 知识; 搜索模式 showing 混合检索; 搜索目录 showing 所有目录. In sidebar results show one folder match, one filename note match and one content match with 第 3 行 plus snippet; 已显示 3 项 and 加载更多搜索结果. A short plain status can say 语义检索暂不可用，已显示文本检索结果 and the existing 检查搜索设置 link. Render no invented retry action in this non-error state. Main pane can retain neutral existing no-note-selected state. The other important states are required contracts, not simultaneously visible claims.
FLAT VISUAL CONTRACT: Match the actual ToDoo reference solely for style. Brand DooKnow and source-owned knowledge controls only. Flat solid #ffffff main/header, #f7f8fa sidebar, #272b3a text, #657084 secondary, #e6e9f1 thin borders, #4566c6 primary, #edf1ff selected. Crisp sans-serif Chinese, thin line icons, 8px radii, restrained shadows. No gradient, texture, grain, glow, bevel or illustration. Desktop primary rail approximately 64px, global header 56px, existing knowledge sidebar approximately 260px with resize divider retained; width is a visual suggestion only, not removal of resizing. Full desktop app host and no browser/device chrome. Source existing owner rail only: O account avatar; 笔记 / 最近 / 收藏 / 应用, bottom 回收站 / 设置. Existing sidebar has 搜索笔记与目录, 新建 split control, heading and add-folder/refresh controls unless source active state suppresses them. Do not transfer ToDoo tasks, goal fields, calendar, notifications or extra navigation. Caption source ID, title, authenticated owner, and the selected visible state only in a separate narrow outer margin.
